title: Potential is not multiplied
promptMarkdown: At 298.15 K use E°(Cu²⁺/Cu) = +0.340 V and E°(Zn²⁺/Zn) = −0.763 V. For Zn(s)+Cu²⁺→Zn²⁺+Cu(s), take a(Zn²⁺)=0.0400 and a(Cu²⁺)=0.00200. Calculate n, Q, E, ΔrG, and log₁₀K. Explain what changes if all stoichiometric coefficients are doubled. Use R=8.31446 J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹, F=96485 C mol⁻¹.
hintLadder: Keep the two tabulated quantities as reduction potentials in E°cathode−E°anode.
Check the doubled reaction algebraically before using numbers.
